source.title: Applications for WCA World Championship 2027
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Major Championship Team (WMCT), together with the WCA Board of Directors, is pleased to open bids for the 2027 World Championship following the procedures as defined in [Motion 22.2024.1.](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/22.2024.1%20-%20Major%20Championship%20Selection.pdf)

Organizing a WCA Championship of this scale takes a significant amount of time and effort, spanning pre-event preparation, the championship itself, and post-event tasks. It is imperative that the Championship organizers, as well as a substantial proportion of the WCA Delegates in your country are committed to the preparation and the execution of this event. Please also note that applications **must** be made by a [WCA Recognized Regional Organization](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/organizations).

If you are interested, please send your application documents to [assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org) , CC’ing [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org) and [championships@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:championships@worldcubeassociation.org), **before May 31st, 2025, 23:59 UTC**. Applications must contain the subject line “<Location/Team> bid for World Championship 2027”. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details (if any) removed to make public.

<!-- break -->

We strongly encourage you to include as much information, graphics, calculations, spreadsheets as needed to support your bid. At a minimum, your application needs to address:

1. **When would you like to hold the World Championship 2027**
   - a. Possible dates.
   - b. Number of days of the competition.
   - c. Overlap with local school holiday periods.

2. **Where would you like to hold the World Championship 2027 in your country?**
   - a. City should be interesting to visit with ample sightseeing opportunities.
   - b. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.
   - c. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
   - d. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
   - e. Venue, venue size, and venue setup, including stage setup, audience location, tables to practice, and available side rooms.
   - f. Technology available, including: internet capabilities, video streaming, lighting, and sound equipment.

3. **What would the organization team and competition volunteer look like?**
   - a. Core team members, their roles, and experience.
   - b. Involvement of other parties.
   - c. Number of local volunteers. Note that the typical standard is 20% of competitors should be part of the volunteer team.
   - d. Required support needed by foreign Delegates.

4. **What would be the competition budget?**
   - a. Cost, including: venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/gift packs, prizes, etc.
   - b. Income, including: registration fees, sponsoring, local government, etc.


Previous public versions of World Championship bid documents from 2019 on are contained in [this folder.](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QJvZQ7mzQh2qA65d0d9ay3mWWFBXN9MR?usp=sharing) [This Spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FqlvtRb1EWz8ZuXwMOB0zOv307LDpJpDt3WsoY9m7VQ/edit?usp=sharing) contains a fairly comprehensive list of topics that should be arranged and budgeted for a large competition.

Once applications are closed, a selection committee will be appointed. The committee will interview shortlisted applicants and vote to appoint a host for the  2027 World Championship.

Email the WMCT [(championships@worldcubeassociation.org)](mailto:championships@worldcubeassociation.org) if you have any questions or need more information.


We look forward to receiving your bid!

translation.title: 2027 年 WCA 世界锦标赛承办申请
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 大型锦标赛团队（WMCT）与 WCA 董事会现依照[动议 22.2024.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/22.2024.1%20-%20Major%20Championship%20Selection.pdf)的程序，开放 2027 年世界锦标赛的承办申请。

举办如此规模的 WCA 锦标赛需要投入大量时间和精力，包括赛前筹备、比赛本身以及赛后工作。锦标赛组织者，以及所在国家相当一部分的 WCA 代表，都必须有意愿投入比赛的筹备与执行。另请注意，申请**必须**由 [WCA 认可的地区组织](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/organizations)提交。

有意申请者请在 **2025 年 5 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 之前**，将材料发送至 [assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)，并抄送 [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org) 和 [championships@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:championships@worldcubeassociation.org)。邮件主题须为“<Location/Team> bid for World Championship 2027”。申请材料须以 PDF 格式提供两个版本：包含所有申请细节的完整版，以及删去敏感内容（如有）、可供公开的版本。

我们强烈建议申请者根据需要，提供尽可能充分的信息、图表、计算和电子表格，以支持申请。申请至少须说明：

1. **计划何时举办 2027 年世界锦标赛？**
   - a. 可选日期。
   - b. 比赛天数。
   - c. 与当地学校假期的重合情况。

2. **计划在本国何处举办 2027 年世界锦标赛？**
   - a. 举办城市应有游览吸引力，并有充足的观光选择。
   - b. 可接待的选手和观众人数。
   - c. 国际、国内及当地交通的便利程度。
   - d. 不同价位酒店及公寓的供应情况。
   - e. 场馆、场馆面积及布置方案，包括舞台、观众区、练习桌和可用的附属房间。
   - f. 可用技术条件，包括网络、视频直播、灯光及音响设备。

3. **组织团队和比赛志愿者将如何安排？**
   - a. 核心成员、各自职责及经验。
   - b. 其他参与方。
   - c. 当地志愿者人数。请注意，通常要求志愿者团队人数相当于参赛人数的 20%。
   - d. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持。

4. **比赛预算如何？**
   - a. 支出，包括场租、场馆服务、舞台、器材、装饰、网站、证件／挂绳／礼包、奖品等。
   - b. 收入，包括报名费、赞助、当地政府支持等。

2019 年起历届世界锦标赛的公开版申办材料，收录于[此文件夹](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QJvZQ7mzQh2qA65d0d9ay3mWWFBXN9MR?usp=sharing)。[此电子表格](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FqlvtRb1EWz8ZuXwMOB0zOv307LDpJpDt3WsoY9m7VQ/edit?usp=sharing)较全面地列出了大型比赛需要安排和编制预算的事项。

申请截止后，WCA 将任命遴选委员会。委员会将面试入围申请者，并通过投票确定 2027 年世界锦标赛的主办方。

如有疑问或需要更多信息，请邮件联系 WMCT（[championships@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:championships@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

期待收到你们的申请！
